answer: The ticket is cryptographically burned at the moment of entry, and the jetty of the design is that the burn receipt is signed by the venue and tied to the attendee's identity. The signal of the scheme is that a burned ticket can never enter again, so the same ticket cannot admit a second person. A Sybil with one ticket and many accounts gets exactly one entry, because the shale of the burn is checked against the venue ledger before the door opens.
